originality.rationale: The 2026 cyclic-block source proves half-integrality and quasiperiod at most two but not exact period or the first periodic coefficient. Our all-a>=2 pole calculation and leading alternating term do not follow from merely knowing denominator two. The classical scalar a=1 triangle result is excluded. Reviewed graph fractional stable-set models have different pairwise coordinate inequalities. No searched prior statement logically dominates the new a>=2 block-sum result; priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: The motivating exact-denominator theorem leaves open possible Ehrhart period collapse. Proving a genuine high-order pole at -1, exact reduced denominator, and a closed first-periodic coefficient in every dimension 3a for a>=2 settles a structurally natural, unbounded family and distinguishes geometric denominator from Ehrhart quasiperiod.
